title: Mukhtasar al-Muzani
author: al-muzani
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Muzani's abridgement of al-Shafi'i's teaching, arranged by the books of the law and noting where he himself would rule otherwise. It was the text through which most later Shafi'is first learned the school.
historicalContext: Al-Muzani was al-Shafi'i's foremost student in Egypt. His Mukhtasar carried the founder's doctrine to the generation that built the school, and the great Shafi'i commentaries of the following centuries were written on it.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
